# The shared cache holds nothing for an `uncached` output, so a target whose
# uncached output is missing or changed runs to produce it again, while a
# missing cached output is still restored.
bit
grep '\Arun\n\z' gen.log
grep '\Arun\n\z' both.log

rm out.txt
bit --plan gen
stdout '^gen ~ .*''out\.txt'' \(removed\) changed\)$'
bit gen
stdout '^gen ▶ '
grep '\Arun\nrun\n\z' gen.log
exists out.txt
bit gen
stdout '^gen · no changes$'

rm skipped.txt
bit --plan both
stdout '^both ~ '
! stdout 'cached'
bit both
stdout '^both ▶ '
grep '\Arun\nrun\n\z' both.log
exists skipped.txt

cp other.txt skipped.txt
bit both
stdout '^both ▶ '
grep '\Arun\nrun\nrun\n\z' both.log
grep '\Askipped\n\z' skipped.txt

rm kept.txt
bit both
stdout '^both │ restore kept\.txt$'
grep '\Arun\nrun\nrun\n\z' both.log
exists kept.txt

-- BUILD.bit --
gen = exec {
  command = "echo run >> gen.log; echo out > out.txt"
  outputs = "out.txt"
  uncached = ["out.txt"]
}

both = exec {
  command = "echo run >> both.log; echo kept > kept.txt; echo skipped > skipped.txt"
  outputs = ["kept.txt", "skipped.txt"]
  uncached = ["skipped.txt"]
}
-- other.txt --
edited
